why: An arXiv preprint (Sept 2025, 'A Density-Based Re-framing Applied to Bipartite Graphs') claims the conjecture holds for bipartite pairs with sufficiently uneven bipartitions and for balanced k-regular bipartite graphs with k>=7, leaving only finitely many small cases unresolved; this looks like a genuine case-restriction of the actual conjecture but was not read closely enough to confirm scope or that it has not been withdrawn/corrected. A separate Zenodo item claiming a full Lean 4 proof by contradiction ('Vizing's Impossible Descent') has no corroboration elsewhere and reads as low-credibility; not treated as evidence.
